The common table setup of the state leagues (the same template in all twelve, only the constants change): fills the table with the state's clubs; returns 1 if it is full. \n +0x3e = `n` clubs; the table (malloc 0x944e46 of n × 0x3b; out of memory: the error box of source `arquivo` at line `linha` and returns 0); the clubs of [0xae23b4] (0x245 bytes, [0xae235c] of them) in the state league of global `g`, in database order, each in the next row (League::init_table_row 0x687430: thiscall(league, row, club, 0, 0), ret 0x10), until full. \n `girar` is 0 (the original: row k gets the k-th club); it exists only for each state league's mutations.

The constructor of a Brazilian state league (the same 544-byte template in all twelve, checked instruction by instruction: only the vtable, the stages, the three own routines, the source file and the line numbers change). \n League::League (0x682200, thiscall, ret 0); +4 = the competition record; the vtable; the year (+0x40, word) = `ano`; the discipline rule (+0x50) = 7. If the saved state loads (League::load_from_temp_file 0x687b10, thiscall(this, 1), ret 4; returns ≠ 0), returns this. \n Otherwise (new career): +0x51 = 0xf (the importance), +0x44 = 0xff, +0x30 = −1, +0x2c = the stages and their array (malloc 0x944e46, unchecked); then, each with its own error box (returning this) if it returns 0: the rules, the table, the fixtures (League::create_fixtures 0x6835c0, thiscall, ret 0) and the sort (League::sort_table 0x6827d0, thiscall(this, 0), ret 4); the stats (operator new 0x944cf1 of 0x5ce and Comp_Stats::Comp_Stats 0x49ee70, thiscall(new, this), ret 4; the original's SEH frame covers only that new) at +8 (without them: the error box); finally the predicted positions.

The constructor of a Brazilian state league (the same 544-byte template in all twelve, checked instruction by instruction: only the vtable, the stages, the three own routines, the source file and the line numbers change). \n League::League (0x682200, thiscall, ret 0); +4 = the competition record; the vtable; the year (+0x40, word) = `ano`; the discipline rule (+0x50) = 7. If the saved state loads (League::load_from_temp_file 0x687b10, thiscall(this, 1), ret 4; returns ≠ 0), returns this. \n Otherwise (new career): +0x51 = 0xf (the importance), +0x44 = 0xff, +0x30 = −1, +0x2c = the stages and their array (malloc 0x944e46, unchecked); then, each with its own error box (returning this) if it returns 0: the rules, the table, the fixtures (League::create_fixtures 0x6835c0, thiscall, ret 0) and the sort (League::sort_table 0x6827d0, thiscall(this, 0), ret 4); the stats (operator new 0x944cf1 of 0x5ce and Comp_Stats::Comp_Stats 0x49ee70, thiscall(new, this), ret 4; the original's SEH frame covers only that new) at +8 (without them: the error box); finally the predicted positions.

The main stage with the Christmas rounds. \n The opening rounds in sequence; then the date of 1 December of the year (Date::Date 0x549f70: push −1; push year; push 0xb; push 1; lea ecx, local -> thiscall, ret 0x10) and the case chosen by the day of the reference round (+0, word; a round of `casos` moved to its weekday): k = (round day − date day + 1, in 16 bits) − `ajuste`; from 0 to 6 it picks the Christmas rounds; otherwise the error box for line `linha` and those of the default case (the eighth); then the closing rounds.

The comparer of the three play-off stage routines: runs only the original and checks the stage, the count and the 4 clubs (as a set). \n The original allocates the list, the round table and the stage and builds the round (only it runs). The plan, made beforehand: the clubs of the 4 rows. Afterwards, the stage of the first slot must exist, with +0x3e = the count (+0xbf), +4 = the league's +4, and the first 4 clubs of its list (+0xa7, 6 bytes) equal to those of the plan (as a set: the round draw 0x51c800 may reorder the ties).

The comparer of the four rule routines, as a dry run: the original builds the round table (it allocates; it does not run twice). \n The original runs in full; the range +0x1c..+0xec is restored to what it was and the copy writes the rules without virtual +0x3c; the fields the copy writes must come out equal to the original's, and the return value must be 1; at the end the original's range is kept (with its round table at +0xba, +0xa9 and +0x3a).

One round of the 0x41-byte table: the date (day, month 0..11, years to add to the league year +0x40, weekday the date is moved to), the code of byte +4 ([inference] the leg) and the TV slots in order (weekday, time slot, number of matches; the list ends with −1).

Writes rounds `primeira`.. of table `t`, in the original's order. \n For each one, the date (0x68a160: push 0; push year; push code; push weekday; push years; push month; push day; push i; push t; add esp -> cdecl: value 0) and the slots (0x68a1c0: push 0; push c; push b; push a; push j; push i; push t; add esp -> cdecl, value 0).

The comparer of the rare finance events, as a dry run (model RARE_FINANCE_EVENT_DRY_RUN: the copy without the news item or the budget, which allocate; without the chairman change in 0x59e940). \n The copy and the original start from the same state (the finance record, the random draw and the `extras`). With no event: everything equal; with an event: the return value, the balance, +0xb4, +0x154, +0x165 and the `conferir` regions (the news type and the +0x82 mark depend on the budget, and so do the random draws after it).

The common body of the French CFA schedule (thiscall(league, stage, &rodadas, &extra, &é_liga), ret 0x10; no saved state): returns the round table. \n Only the main stage (−1) builds it; the others return 0 without writing anything. é_liga (if requested) = 1, the rounds, extra = 0, a table of rounds × 0x41 bytes (malloc 0x944e46: push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; out of memory: the error box and 0) with the league's dates and slots.
The ids of the competitions whose clubs all enter; the others come from the generic division ([0x9cf764]).

The body of the two French lower-league constructors (thiscall(this, year), ret 4, SEH frame only on the exception path; no saved state). 
 The base (League::League 0x682200: mov ecx -> thiscall, ret 0), the vtable, the year (+0x40), +0x2c = 0, no discipline (+0x50 = 0xff), the record (+4), stage 0xff (+0x44) and −1 (+0x30); the rules (0x5ba0a0: mov ecx -> thiscall, ret 0; on failure, the error box and stop). 
 Then the club list, in database order (the first [0xae235c] − 2 × [0xae2350]), up to the maximum: those of the `todas` competitions; and, up to the generic maximum, those of the generic division meeting the league's condition. The list is shuffled (comp_util_shuffle_pointer_array 0x4afb40: push count; push list; add esp, 8 -> cdecl; uses the random draw) and each group, with its clubs consecutive in the list, gets the table (on failure, the error box), the fixtures (League::create_fixtures 0x6835c0: mov ecx -> thiscall, ret 0; on failure, the error box) and the table is released (League::free_table 0x687970: push 0; mov ecx -> thiscall, ret 4): the group's matches stay in the game calendar and the league carries on without a table. 
 The list is a local record of 72 or 40 pointers; the copy uses a zeroed array (the career fills the list; the original would read stack garbage without enough clubs).

The comparer of the three routines: the original allocates the table and pays the TV money (with a news item), so only it runs; checked against a plan made beforehand. \n The plan: the division's clubs in database order (up to `n`). Afterwards: +0x3e = `n`, the return value = 1 if the plan filled up, the rows with the plan's clubs in order and, when full, +0xe1 and +0x28 as the routine writes them (`cota`: the share fund and 1; None: 0 and 2).

Writes rounds `primeira`.. of table `t`, in the original's order. \n For each one, the date (0x68a160: push 0; push year; push code; push weekday; push years; push month; push day; push i; push t; add esp -> cdecl: value 0) and the slots (0x68a1c0: push 0; push c; push b; push a; push j; push i; push t; add esp -> cdecl, value 0).
The bottom division: the same table as the second one, with the TV slot also in the last two rounds.

Writes rounds `primeira`.. of table `t`, in the original's order. \n For each one, the date (0x68a160: push 0; push year; push code; push weekday; push years; push month; push day; push i; push t; add esp -> cdecl: value 0) and the slots (0x68a1c0: push 0; push c; push b; push a; push j; push i; push t; add esp -> cdecl, value 0), from a static table.

The play-off match of the Italian leagues (stage 0, one 0x68-byte cup round, `eng_cc_cup_write_cup_round`; the year +0x40 signed). \n The draw and the match in May of the following year (Serie A: draw on 13 May, match on 19 May; Serie B: 15 May and 21 May), name 0xa0, no draw (0x200), tie-break 3, category 5, two legs (+0x21 = 2) with 3 days between the matches, no prizes; the teams (2n teams, n matches, 2n new entrants) from the league's byte +0xee (n, signed; arithmetic in 16 bits as in the original) [inference: the requested play-off ties].

The body of the four Italian division constructors (thiscall(this, year, record), ret 8, SEH frame only for the operator new); returns this. \n The base (League::League 0x682200: mov ecx -> thiscall, ret 0), the record (+4), the vtable, the year (+0x40) and discipline rule 0x11 (+0x50, the Italian leagues' one); it tries to load the state (League::load_from_temp_file 0x687b10: push 1; mov ecx -> thiscall, ret 4). If it loaded: done. \n Otherwise, the new league: in A and B, +0xee = 0 and +0x4c = 1; stage 0xff (+0x44), current stage −1 (+0x30), +0x2c stages and the array [+0xc] (malloc 0x944e46 of 4 × stages: push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; 0 with no stages); the rules and the table (error box and stop if they fail); the real 2001/02 calendar (unchecked); the fixtures (League::create_fixtures 0x6835c0), the sort (League::sort_table 0x6827d0: push 0 -> thiscall, ret 4), the stats (operator new 0x944cf1 of 0x5ce: push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; Comp_Stats::Comp_Stats 0x49ee70: push league; mov ecx, new -> thiscall, ret 4) at +8 and the predicted positions (0x68a850: mov ecx -> thiscall, ret 0).

Creates the end-of-league stages: the champion goes to the Serie C1 Super Cup, and the play-off and play-out Cup_Stages are built with their first-round draw. Body of both 0x64ba70 and 0x64fc30, identical except for the source file, the line numbers and the order in which the lists are freed at the end. 
 1) The champion (row 0) goes to the Serie C1 Super Cup (competition [[0xadadfc] + [0x9cf938] × 4], entrant list [+0xa7] of 6 bytes): in slot 0 if empty, otherwise in slot 1. 
 2) The 4-club list (malloc 0x944e46 of 0x10: push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; out of memory: the error box for line `linhas[0]` and return) with those in the play-off rows (PROMOTION_PLAYOFF_ROWS). 
 3) The stage 0 schedule (virtual +0x3c: push 0; push &extra; push &rodadas; push 0; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0x10; returns the template; `rodadas` and `extra` are words). 
 4) The stage (operator new 0x944cf1 of 0xb2: push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; Cup_Stage::Cup_Stage 0x522e00: 15 arguments pushed, mov ecx, new -> thiscall, ret 0x3c: the league, the clubs (+0xbf, signed byte), the list, the rounds, the competition record (+4), the template, the year (+0x40), 0, 1, the `extra`, 0x14, 0, 0, 0 and the table positions of the 4 (local 4-byte record: 4, 1, 3, 2)) goes to [+0xc][0]; no stage: the error box for line `linhas[1]` and return; otherwise the first-round draw (Cup::set_up_round 0x51c800: push 0; mov ecx, stage -> thiscall, ret 4) and the template is freed (0x9452ca: push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl). 
 5) The same with stage 1 and the play-out clubs (PLAYOUT_ROWS; positions 16, 13, 15, 14 in the local record and 1, 1 in the two bytes) at [+0xc][1]; frees the list and the template (in `lista_primeiro` order); no stage: the error box for line `linhas[2]`; otherwise the first-round draw and +0x30 = 1. 
 The high bits of the words the original pushes as dwords (the clubs, the rounds, the year and the `extra`) are garbage from the stack or other registers; the constructor reads only the word (0x522e00: mov ax, word ptr [esp + ...]) and the copy passes zero there.

The comparer of an MLS division stage: runs only the original (it allocates the array, the round table and the stage), checked against the plan made beforehand. \n The plan: the clubs with the code, in database order. Afterwards, the stage in slot k with the league's +0x3e, the clubs in its table (as a set), +0x3a = the code and +0x30 = k.
The three European cups of squad registration, in order: the Champions League, the UEFA Cup and the Cup Winners' Cup [inference] (the keys of the competition ids).

The preferred squad numbers (index = number − 1) by the positions of player sheet `f` (position ratings from 1 to 20, "good" = 15 or more). \n Goalkeeper (+0xf): 1; defender or sweeper (+0x11, +0x10): 2 if he plays on the right (+0x17), 3 if on the left (+0x18), otherwise 4, 5 or 6; defensive midfielder, midfielder or attacking midfielder (+0x12, +0x13, +0x14): 6, 7 or 8; forward (+0x15): 8, 9, 10 or 11. Ends with 0xff. \n None of the positions good: `None` (the original then reads the 4-byte list with no value on the stack, see `comparar_allocate_squad_number`).
The slots of 0x85aae0's reference lineup: the 11 starters and up to 14 substitutes (those of 0x859fe0, `SQUAD_MANAGER_REFERENCE_LINEUP_SLOTS`, up to the 19th; the 20th here is a goalkeeper's).

Club `c` gets the place in competition `comp`, at phase `fase`, if it has a nation and has no place yet (+0x1db = −1). \n Sets +0x1db = comp, +0x1df = fase and counts one more club for nation `i` (+0x11). Returns whether it got the place. (The case of a nation with no entry, −1, which the original looks up by the club's nation, does not happen: `i` always comes from the loop over the nations.)

Comparer for `report_poor_fitness` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n The original runs alone (it puts the record in the list, gives the news item and fines) and the plan is checked: with non-null player and club, the record with the player, the club and today's date (16 bytes; byte +0x10 is stack leftover) is placed right after the previous tail (or at the head, if the list was empty).

Comparer for `add_transfer_totals` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n The records may be created (realloc) and the news item reallocates: the four records are requested beforehand, in the original's order (seller: season, all-time; buyer: season, all-time; the second time only finds them), and if the news queue has no room for two, only the original runs. Otherwise side by side over the four records (+0x365, 12 bytes), the news count and the next two slots.

Comparer for `draw_round` (0x51c410; comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n Only the original runs (the random draws draw, the news item allocates). The plan, made beforehand: with no draw (no +0x45 or already drawn), nothing changes in the ties or the dates; with a team still open, the predicted dates of the rounds (this one plus 1 day, the following ones at least that); once drawn, all ties with +0x34 = 1 and +0xac with the predicted sum (the news item's queries do not change with the draw).

Comparer for `cup_rank_teams` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n It writes and may reallocate the stats (it does not run twice): before the original, the positions are planned on a sorted copy of the array (the keys in a Vec); afterwards, each planned club's record must have its last position at +0x72.

Comparer for `set_up_teams` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n Side by side from the same state (the random generator, +0x3e, the two All-Star clubs and [0xb67a34]); the original leaves its list at +0xa7, the copy builds its own (without counting the random draw), which is compared over the 12 bytes and freed. The old list (+0xa7 on entry) is freed by neither of them (the season rollover has already freed it).

Comparer for `draw_phase1_groups` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n Only the original runs (it draws, pays prizes, allocates the stages and sends news), checked against the plan made beforehand: with 32 clubs, the 8 stages in [+0xc], +0x30 = 7, and the clubs of the stage tables (+0xb1, rows of 0x3b bytes, 4 per stage) are exactly the 32 of the plan.

Comparer for `european_cup_collect_entrants` (0x584fa0; comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n The original allocates (only it runs); the plan then checks everything it wrote: the new list, copied and refilled by the copy (fill_champions_league_entrants only reads the clubs, which the original does not change), must come out equal, as must +0x36, +0x38 and the return value.

Comparer for `collect_day_clashes` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n The copy as a dry run (it stores the matches instead of appending them, with its own severity) and the original from the same state; it checks the severity and the new nodes at the end of the list (the 0x4f bytes of each match, in order). The day lists (0x5abf10) have their cursor reset in both.

Comparer for `queue_fixture_moved_news` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs), as a dry run. \n Already in the queue: side by side on the queue header and the found news item (the new date). New: the copy builds the news item without queueing it and the original runs; the queue must grow by one and the last item (the tail, +6, node +0) must be the copy's news item over the 0xde bytes the constructor (0x77bbe0) writes; the last of the 0xdf copied bytes is stack leftover in the original (the copy puts zero).

Comparer for `plan_club_friendlies` (0x5c4770; comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n Only the original runs (simplification: it frees and allocates the plan, and 0x5c4380 allocates the candidates' date and opponent lists; it does not run twice), checking the plan it leaves: the plan allocated, the capacity (+0x34e4) not lower than the count (+0x34e0), +0x34dc zeroed and the plan in date order (0x778e90 between neighbours).

Comparer for `add_friendly_match` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n It allocates and appends to the list (it does not run twice): the original does it and the copy checks the result against the home side's stadium, looked up beforehand (0x5ae870, read-only): occupied → 0; otherwise the returned friendly has the date, +0xc the club, +8 = 0, +0x18 = 1 and home and away sides according to `em_casa`.

Comparer for `draw_finalists` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n Side by side: +0xf2, [0xb67a34] and the random generator state from the same state (the copy draws without counting); the original leaves its groups at +0xee, the copy builds its own, compared over the 16 slots and freed (without the 16, the lists of 50 are compared over the first 16 slots).

Comparer for `create_fixtures` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n Only the original runs (simplification: it allocates the grid, draws the club order and puts the matches in the calendar, which allocates: it does not run twice). It checks what the routine guarantees: with the year's own list, that list is freed (+0xea = 0) when it returns 1.

Comparer for `league_add_result` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n The null match and the stage match (the stage's virtual receives the match and compares on its own): only the original. In the other cases, a dry run: the copy without the stats (0x49f570 finds or creates records) and the original from the same state: the date at +0xc9, the table rows with the head-to-heads (the regions of 0x685f60), the match's +0x3d/+0x3e and the return value.

Comparer for `init_table_row` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n The original allocates (history and head-to-heads): only it runs, and the row is checked against the plan made beforehand (the total rounds, the club's status, the fields, the zeroed blocks, the arrays present and, on the last row, each row's opponents).

Comparer for `bra_nat_third_start_new_season` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n Only the original runs (simplification: it frees tables and stages, allocates the new ones, draws fixtures, officials and groups; it cannot run twice), checking what only it guarantees: the year + 1, the seven groups in slots 0 to 6 and the list of 56 zeroed.

Comparer for `bra_nat_third_create_table` (the Série C; comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n The original frees, allocates and draws: only it runs. The plan, made beforehand: the clubs whose division is [this+4], in database order, up to 56. Afterwards: return value 1, +0x3e = 7, the list (+0xee) with the plan's clubs in some order (the random draw) and table rows 0..6 with the first 7 of the list.

Comparer for `bra_reg_minas_gerais_record_season_honours` (end of season; comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n Only the original runs (simplification: it writes the history, which allocates the record, pays the prizes and sends the news item, and may set up the Champions Cup; it cannot run twice). The copy runs in Rust mode (counters "cqo_7 historico da final" and "cqo_7 premios") and is proved by the mutations and by the two Rust careers.

Comparer for `bra_reg_parana_record_season_honours` (end of season; comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n Only the original runs (simplification: it writes the history, which allocates the record, pays the prizes and sends the news item, and may set up the Champions Cup; it cannot run twice). The copy runs in Rust mode (counters "cqo_8 historico da final" and "cqo_8 premios") and is proved by the mutations and by the two Rust careers.

Comparer for `eng_second_update_staff_records_for_status` (0x576c50; comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n The records write the history to the file, draw the morale and may renew contracts (they do not run twice): only the original runs. The plan, made beforehand, in the knockout: the club's first row decides what the routine writes (+0x37 = 0 and saiu = 1 with 1; +0x37 = 0xfe with 0xff or 2; nothing with 0, which keeps looking for another row of the same club); afterwards the row and `saiu` must be like that. In the league the routine writes nothing: only the return value is checked.

Comparer for `create_championship_final_stage` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n Only the original runs (it allocates the list, the table and the stage and draws the round), checked against the plan made beforehand: the champions of the two halves. Afterwards, the stage of the third slot exists, with +0x3e = 2, +4 = the league's +4 and the two champions in its list (+0xa7, 6 bytes; as a set), and +0x30 = 2.

Comparer for `spa_lower_create_table` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n It allocates and draws: only the original runs. The plan, made beforehand: the B teams (of the Primera and the Segunda) in the first rows. Afterwards: +0x3e and the club of the first rows. +0x60 is not checked: the second pass (the one for the Segunda's B teams) zeroes +0x60 of every Spanish team that does not enter it, including the Primera ones the first pass has just put in the table (behaviour of the original, which the copy repeats; found by the 8-league comparison, 05/11/2026).

Comparer for `assign_league_squad_numbers` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n Side by side: +0x3a of the contracts (the club one and the loan one) of everyone in the squad of each league club and of the linked club, and the error box mark. If some club has a human manager without `automatico` (the request news item cannot run twice), only the original runs. The club list comes from the same method +0x58 (freed afterwards).

Comparer for `world_cup_create_group_stage` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n Only the original runs (it allocates the stage and sends the news item), checking the plan: it returns 1 with the stage in [+0xc][g], +0x30 = g, the stage with the World Cup's team count (+0x3e) and year and, in the stage table (+0xb1, rows of 0x3b bytes), the clubs of group g+2 of the list (in any order: in the 02/11 comparison the stage rows did not come out in list order [inference: the stage sorts or draws its own table]).

Comparer for `process_due_decision_dates` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n The offer decision (0x4ce4e0) changes the contracts, the offers and the array itself: the plan (the dates read beforehand, without running anything) tells whether any type-3 entry with a person falls due; if so, only the original runs. If not (the everyday case), side by side over index +0x18 and the entries that fall due (they become −1).

Comparer for `database_generate_extra_non_playing_staff` (0x527240; comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n Original and copy side by side over the whole club and person tables, [0x9b59b4], the text at 0xde1f64 and the random generator state (the copy without counting draws). With a person of job 8 outside the slots (error box), only the original runs. Overflowing the 23,000 (error box) is not anticipated here: the factory database generates far fewer.

Comparer for `clear_bans_invalid_for_club` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n 0x556270 releases bans (nation index, governing bodies): the plan beforehand (the slots the club does not cover and the entries), then the original runs; it checks the freed slots (0xff, −1, entry −1) and that the others are intact. An entry repeated in two slots is not checked for the second one.

Comparer for `add_injury` (0x62d250; comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n Only the original runs (it allocates, delivers the news item, schedules retirement and calls original routines that draw random numbers along the way, such as training 0x8b1750 and relapse 0x62e500, which may injure again: it cannot run twice). It checks what the injury guarantees afterwards: invalid arguments or recurrence only give −1; otherwise −1 only with the person still injured (+0xe ≠ −1) or with no array; a valid slot with the person still in it (+0xe = slot, with no relapse having changed it): the type in the slot and at +0x1d, +0x1c = 0, +0x2c = +0x28, +0x2e = +0x2a, and +0x2a = the return to training from duration +0x28 (the copy's x87).

Comparer for `update_player_fitness` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs), side by side. \n Compared: the person's 31-byte record, byte +0xa of the 79-byte record, the statics and the club's saved data (0xb63d08..0xb63d34), and the random draw.
